title: TagsBits
description: TagsBits is a complete tag and economy plugin for Paper and Purpur servers, combining player customization, progression systems, and interactive financial features in one lightweight solution.
body:
�️ TagsBits

TagsBits is a complete tag and economy plugin for Paper and Purpur servers, combining player customization, progression systems, and interactive financial features in one lightweight solution.

Players can purchase, equip, and collect dozens of tags through beautiful GUI menus with categories and pagination. Tags support temporary or permanent durations, automatic expiration checks, and seamless LuckPerms integration to instantly update chat prefixes.

The plugin also includes a built-in economy system with ore selling, multiple savings plans with investment returns, NPC support, and PlaceholderAPI compatibility. Administrators can easily manage tags, categories, balances, and player data through powerful commands and a fully configurable setup.

Powered by SQLite with WAL mode, automatic saves, and optimized data handling, TagsBits delivers excellent performance without requiring external database dependencies.

Key Features:

🏷️ Advanced Tag System with categories and GUI menus
💰 Integrated Economy and Ore Selling
🏦 Savings System with investment rewards
🔌 LuckPerms and PlaceholderAPI support
🤖 FancyNpcs and Citizens integration
🗄️ Embedded SQLite storage (no setup required)
⚡ Lightweight, optimized, and highly customizable

Give your players identity, progression, and new goals with TagsBits.
